name: What is the difference between a custom tile shower and a prefabricated shower surround?

mainEntity.name: What is the difference between a custom tile shower and a prefabricated shower surround?

acceptedAnswer.text: Custom tile showers offer complete design flexibility, allowing you to tailor wall patterns, shower floor mosaics, recessed niches, and built-in benches to your exact bathroom dimensions. However, tile requires meticulous waterproofing and ongoing grout cleaning. Prefabricated acrylic or composite panels offer faster installation and seamless, low-maintenance surfaces, but they come in fixed dimensions and offer fewer design options compared to custom masonry work.
acceptedAnswer.description: Custom tile offers endless aesthetic choices and built-in features but requires more maintenance, while prefabricated units install faster with seamless, low-maintenance walls.
